   184	      rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
   185	    _ = (∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a) /
   186	        ∑ b ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight b := by
   187	      rw [Finset.sum_div]
   188	    _ = 1 := div_self hpos.ne'
   189	
   190	/-! ### Push-forwards of finite and uniform distributions
   191	
   192	The results of this section are not named in the paper.  They record the
   193	elementary behaviour of push-forwards of finite distributions, and of uniform
   194	distributions on finite types, that the line-point samplers of the low-degree
   195	game and the identification of question distributions with typed conditionally
   196	linear distributions rely on.
   197	-/
   198	
   199	/-- Two finite distributions coincide as soon as their supports and weight
   200	functions coincide.  This is the formalization support statement
   201	`lem:distribution-ext-support` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   202	theorem Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight {α : Type*} {μ ν : Distribution α}
   203	    (hsupport : μ.support = ν.support) (hweight : μ.weight = ν.weight) :
   204	    μ = ν := by
   205	  cases μ with
   206	  | mk s w hn ho =>
   207	    cases ν with
   208	    | mk s' w' hn' ho' =>
   209	      have hs : s = s' := hsupport
   210	      have hw : w = w' := hweight
   211	      subst hs
   212	      subst hw
   213	      rfl
   214	
   215	/-- Successive push-forwards of a finite distribution compose.  This is
   216	`lem:distribution-map-comp` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   217	theorem Distribution.map_map {α β γ : Type*}
   218	    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
   219	    (μ : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → γ) :
   220	    (μ.map e).map f = μ.map fun a => f (e a) := by
   221	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   222	  · change (μ.support.image e).image f = μ.support.image fun a => f (e a)
   223	    rw [Finset.image_image]
   224	    rfl
   225	  · funext c
   226	    have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c,
   227	        e a ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c := by
   228	      intro a ha
   229	      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
   230	      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha1, ha2⟩
   231	    have hkey := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps μ.weight
   232	    change (∑ b ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c,
   233	        ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => e a = b, μ.weight a) =
   234	      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c, μ.weight a
   235	    rw [← hkey]
   236	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
   237	    obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
   238	    congr 1
   239	    ext a
   240	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
   241	    constructor
   242	    · rintro ⟨ha1, rfl⟩
   243	      exact ⟨⟨ha1, hb2⟩, rfl⟩
   244	    · rintro ⟨⟨ha1, -⟩, hae⟩
   245	      exact ⟨ha1, hae⟩
   246	
   247	/-- Every point of a nonempty finite type carries the reciprocal of the type's
   248	cardinality as its uniform weight.  This is `lem:uniform-distribution-weight`
   249	in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   250	theorem uniformDistribution_weight_apply (α : Type*)
   251	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] (a : α) :
   252	    (uniformDistribution α).weight a = 1 / (Fintype.card α : Error) := by
   253	  simp [uniformDistribution]
   254	
   255	/-- A map whose fibers all have the same cardinality pushes the uniform
   256	distribution forward to the uniform distribution.  This is
   257	`lem:uniform-map-equal-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   258	theorem uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber {α β : Type*}
   259	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   260	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
   261	    (e : α → β) (c : ℕ)
   262	    (hc : ∀ b : β, ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b).card = c) :
   263	    (uniformDistribution α).map e = uniformDistribution β := by
   264	  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
   265	    obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty α)
   266	    have hmem : a₀ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = e a₀ :=
   267	      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
   268	    have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a₀, hmem⟩
   269	    rwa [hc] at hpos
   270	  have hcard : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card β * c := by
   271	    have h := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
   272	      (f := e) (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (t := (Finset.univ : Finset β))
   273	      (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
   274	    rw [Finset.card_univ] at h
   275	    rw [h, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hc b]
   276	    simp [Finset.card_univ, mul_comm]
   277	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   278	  · change (Finset.univ : Finset α).image e = (Finset.univ : Finset β)
   279	    ext b
   280	    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true, true_and]
   281	    have hne : ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b).Nonempty := by
   282	      rw [← Finset.card_pos, hc]
   283	      exact hcpos
   284	    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne
   285	    exact ⟨a, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩
   286	  · funext b
   287	    have hbeta : (Fintype.card β : Error) ≠ 0 := by
   288	      exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := β)
   289	    have hc' : (c : Error) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcpos.ne'
   290	    change (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b,
   291	        (uniformDistribution α).weight a) = (uniformDistribution β).weight b
   292	    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => uniformDistribution_weight_apply α a,
   293	      uniformDistribution_weight_apply, Finset.sum_const, hc, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
   294	    push_cast
   295	    field_simp
   296	
   297	/-- Relabelling along a bijection preserves uniformity.  This is
   298	`lem:uniform-map-equivalence` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   299	theorem uniformDistribution_map_equiv {α β : Type*}
   300	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   301	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] (E : α ≃ β) :
   302	    (uniformDistribution α).map E = uniformDistribution β := by
   303	  refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ 1 fun b => ?_
   304	  have hfilter :
   305	      ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => E a = b) = {E.symm b} := by
   306	    ext a
   307	    simp [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply]
   308	  rw [hfilter]
   309	  simp
   310	
   311	/-- The first marginal of the uniform distribution on a product is uniform.
   312	This is `lem:uniform-product-first-marginal` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   313	theorem uniformDistribution_map_fst {α β : Type*}
   314	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   315	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
   316	    (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map Prod.fst = uniformDistribution α := by
   317	  refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ (Fintype.card β) fun a => ?_
   318	  have hfilter : ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => p.1 = a)
   319	      = ({a} : Finset α) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset β) := by
   320	    ext p
   321	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_product,
   322	      Finset.mem_singleton, and_true]
   323	  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_product]
   324	  simp
   325	
   326	/-- The second marginal of the uniform distribution on a product is uniform.
   327	This is `lem:uniform-product-second-marginal` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   328	theorem uniformDistribution_map_snd {α β : Type*}
   329	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   330	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
   331	    (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map Prod.snd = uniformDistribution β := by
   332	  refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ (Fintype.card α) fun b => ?_
   333	  have hfilter : ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => p.2 = b)
   334	      = (Finset.univ : Finset α) ×ˢ ({b} : Finset β) := by
   335	    ext p
   336	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_product,
   337	      Finset.mem_singleton]
   338	  rw [hfilter, Finset.card_product]
   339	  simp
   340	
   341	/-- Binding a uniform distribution to a family of uniformly seeded
   342	push-forwards is the push-forward of the uniform distribution on the product.
   343	This is `lem:uniform-bind-map` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   344	theorem bind_uniformDistribution_map {α β γ : Type*}
   345	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   346	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] [DecidableEq γ]
   347	    (g : α → β → γ) :
   348	    Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution α)
   349	        (fun a => (uniformDistribution β).map (g a)) =
   350	      (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map fun p => g p.1 p.2 := by
   351	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   352	  · change (Finset.univ : Finset α).biUnion
   353	        (fun a => (Finset.univ : Finset β).image (g a)) =
   354	      (Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).image fun p => g p.1 p.2
   355	    ext c
   356	    simp [Prod.exists]
   357	  · funext c
   358	    have hcount :
   359	        ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => g p.1 p.2 = c).card
   360	          = ∑ a : α, ((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card := by
   361	      simp only [Finset.card_filter]
   362	      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
   363	    have hinner : ∀ a : α,
   364	        ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c
   365	          = (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : Error) *
   366	              (1 / (Fintype.card β : Error)) := by
   367	      intro a
   368	      change (∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c,
   369	          (uniformDistribution β).weight b) = _
   370	      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => uniformDistribution_weight_apply β b,
   371	        Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
   372	    have key : ∀ a : α, (uniformDistribution α).weight a *
   373	        ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c
   374	        = (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : Error) *
   375	            (1 / ((Fintype.card α : Error) * (Fintype.card β : Error))) := by
   376	      intro a
   377	      rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply, hinner a]
   378	      ring
   379	    change (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α), (uniformDistribution α).weight a *
   380	        ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c) =
   381	      ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => g p.1 p.2 = c,
   382	        (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight p
   383	    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => key a, ← Finset.sum_mul,
   384	      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => uniformDistribution_weight_apply (α × β) p,
   385	      Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcount, Fintype.card_prod]
   386	    push_cast
   387	    ring
   388	
   389	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

1	import MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.PMFAverages
     2	import MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.DistributionAux
     3	
     4	/-!
     5	# Marginals of probability distributions
     6	
     7	The finite-distribution push-forward calculus gives corresponding identities
     8	for probability mass functions and for projections transported across finite
     9	equivalences.  These forms are used by the directly indexed low-degree
    10	line-point laws and by the correspondence between the seed-indexed and directly
    11	indexed question distributions.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`
    16	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    24	
    25	/-- Two probabilistic finite distributions with the same stored support and
    26	the same associated probability mass function are equal.  This is the PMF form
    27	of `Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight`, retained for the low-degree
    28	marginal arguments that are stated using `Distribution.toPMF`. -/
    29	theorem distribution_eq_of_support_eq_of_toPMF_eq {alpha : Type*}
    30	    (mu nu : Distribution alpha) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
    31	    (hnu : nu.IsProbability) (hsupport : mu.support = nu.support)
    32	    (hpmf : mu.toPMF hmu = nu.toPMF hnu) : mu = nu := by
    33	  have hweight : mu.weight = nu.weight := by
    34	    funext a
    35	    calc
    36	      mu.weight a = (mu.toPMF hmu a).toReal :=
    37	        (Distribution.toPMF_apply_toReal mu hmu a).symm
    38	      _ = (nu.toPMF hnu a).toReal := by rw [hpmf]
    39	      _ = nu.weight a := Distribution.toPMF_apply_toReal nu hnu a
    40	  exact Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight hsupport hweight
    41	
    42	/-- Composition of two push-forwards of a probabilistic finite distribution
    43	is the push-forward by the composite map.  This probability-specialized form
    44	is retained for the directly indexed low-degree marginal theorems. -/
    45	theorem distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
    46	    {alpha beta gamma : Type*} [DecidableEq beta] [DecidableEq gamma]
    47	    (mu : Distribution alpha) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
    48	    (f : alpha → beta) (g : beta → gamma) :
    49	    (mu.map f).map g = mu.map (g ∘ f) := by
    50	  change (mu.map f).map g = mu.map fun a => g (f a)
    51	  exact (fun _ : mu.IsProbability => Distribution.map_map mu f g) hmu
    52	
    53	/-- Projection onto the first factor of an explicit finite product
    54	equivalence sends the uniform distribution to the uniform first marginal.
    55	This form combines invariance under equivalence with the uniform first-marginal
    56	identity; it is `lem:uniform-first-marginal-after-equivalence` in blueprint
    57	chapter 13. -/
    58	theorem uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
    59	    {alpha beta gamma : Type*}
    60	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] [Nonempty alpha]
    61	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta] [Nonempty beta]
    62	    [Finite gamma] [Nonempty gamma]
    63	    (e : alpha ≃ beta × gamma) (f : alpha → beta)
    64	    (hf : ∀ a, f a = (e a).1) :
    65	    (uniformDistribution alpha).map f = uniformDistribution beta := by
    66	  classical
    67	  letI : Fintype gamma := Fintype.ofFinite gamma
    68	  calc
    69	    (uniformDistribution alpha).map f =
    70	        (uniformDistribution alpha).map (fun a => (e a).1) := by
    71	      congr 1
    72	      funext a
    73	      exact hf a
    74	    _ = ((uniformDistribution alpha).map e).map Prod.fst :=
    75	      (Distribution.map_map _ _ _).symm
    76	    _ = (uniformDistribution (beta × gamma)).map Prod.fst := by
    77	      rw [uniformDistribution_map_equiv]
    78	    _ = uniformDistribution beta := uniformDistribution_map_fst
    79	
    80	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

     6	/-!
     7	# The low-degree game
     8	
     9	The low-degree component of the Pauli basis test has finite question and answer
    10	alphabets.  Its question maps act explicitly on the point, coordinate, and
    11	direction registers of the ambient coefficient space and have recursive
    12	conditionally linear representations of levels one, two, and three.
    13	
    14	## References
    15	
    16	The source-facing nodes are `def:ld-game`, `def:ld-question-distribution`, and
    17	`def:ld-win-predicate` in
    18	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`; their paper origin is
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    20	The exact decomposition of a scalar seed into its coordinate index and its
    21	residue records the balance assertion for the map `chi` in the same source
    22	definition.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	open scoped BigOperators
    26	
    27	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    28	
    29	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    30	
    31	noncomputable section
    32	
    33	/-- Numerical parameters for the low-degree game.  The ambient coefficient
    34	space uses the once-and-for-all model `fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq`, rather than a
    35	model supplied by each parameter record.  This is the Lean carrier for
    36	`def:ld-game` in
    37	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, with paper origin
    38	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    39	-/
    40	structure LdParams where
    41	  q : ℕ
    42	  m : ℕ
    43	  d : ℕ
    44	  k : ℕ
    45	  hm : 1 ≤ m
    46	  hd : 1 ≤ d
    47	  hk : 1 ≤ k
    48	  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
    49	  hdvd : m ∣ q
    50	
    51	/-- The positive dimension in `LdParams` supplies the finite coordinate type
    52	used by the uniform axis and prefix-index marginals. -/
    53	instance (L : LdParams) : Nonempty (Fin L.m) :=
    54	  ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm⟩⟩
    55	
    56	/-- The fixed model accessor for an `LdParams` record.  It is a compatibility
    57	view of the global `fixedFieldModel` selector, not an independently quantified
    58	parameter.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    59	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    60	-/
    61	noncomputable def LdParams.model (P : LdParams) : FixedFieldModel P.q :=
    62	  fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq
    63	
    64	/-- The scalar carrier selected by an `LdParams` record; this is the fixed
    65	field carrier in `def:ld-game`, selected globally by `LdParams.model`.
    66	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
    67	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    68	-/
    69	abbrev ScalarQ (P : LdParams) := (P.model).K
    70	
    71	/-- The three low-degree question types of `def:ld-game`, blueprint
    72	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
    73	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    74	-/
    75	inductive LdType where
    76	  | point
    77	  | aline
    78	  | dline
    79	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, Fintype
    80	
    81	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    82	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    83	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    84	-/
    85	abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m
    86	
    87	/-- The full ambient low-degree coefficient space (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    88	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    89	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    90	-/
    91	abbrev LdSpace (P : LdParams) := LdIndex P → ScalarQ P
    92	
    93	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
    94	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    95	-/
    96	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
    97	  fun i => z (.inl (.inl i))
    98	
    99	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
   100	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   101	-/
   102	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=
   103	  z (.inl (.inr ()) )
   104	
   105	/-- The direction coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
   106	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   107	-/
   108	def LdSpace.direction {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   109	  fun i => z (.inr i)
   110	
   111	/-- The integer-coordinate map `χ` from the fixed field representation.  This
   112	is `eq:chi-func` in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   113	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   114	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   115	-/
   116	noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
   117	  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
   118	    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   119	  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
   120	
   121	/-! ### Equal fibers of the coordinate-index map -/
   122	
   123	/-- The common residue set in a fiber of `chiIndex` is nonempty.  This is part
   124	of the exact seed decomposition supporting the balance assertion in
   125	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `lem:chi-seed-fibers`, paper
   126	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:215-221`.
   127	-/
   128	theorem LdParams.seedFiberCard_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   129	  exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by
   130	    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := L.hq
   131	    rw [hq]
   132	    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) L.hdvd) L.hm
   133	
   134	/-- Divisibility identifies the scalar cardinality with the product of the
   135	coordinate-index cardinality and the common fiber cardinality.  This supports
   136	`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   137	theorem LdParams.seedFiberProduct_eq (L : LdParams) :
   138	    L.q = L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
   139	  (Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd).symm
   140	
   141	/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
   142	natural-number representative. -/

   148	/-- A scalar seed is uniquely a coordinate index and a residue in its

   169	      (binaryRepresentation L.model s)).val / (L.q / L.m) =
   170	      (Fin.ofNat L.m ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m))).val

   233	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)

   235	  fun i => match i with

     8	Shared distribution definitions: finite-support weighted distributions,

    22	/-- A finite-support weighted distribution with nonnegative real-valued weights. -/
    23	structure Distribution (α : Type*) where
    24	  support : Finset α := ∅
    25	  weight : α → Error := fun _ => 0
    26	  nonnegative : ∀ a, 0 ≤ weight a := by intro _; positivity
    27	  outsideSupport : ∀ a, a ∉ support → weight a = 0 := by intro _ _; rfl
    28	
    29	namespace Distribution
    30	
    31	/-- The total mass carried by the explicit support of a distribution. -/
    32	def totalWeight {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) : Error :=
    33	  ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a
    34	
    35	/-- A `Distribution` is probabilistic when its total mass is exactly `1`. -/
    36	def IsProbability {α : Type*} (𝒟 : Distribution α) : Prop :=
    37	  𝒟.totalWeight = 1
    38	
    39	/-- Push a finite-support distribution forward along a map.
    40	
    41	This is the project `Distribution` analogue of `PMF.map`.  The support is the
    42	image of the original finite support, and each new weight is the sum of the
    43	weights in the corresponding fiber. -/
    44	noncomputable def map {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    45	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) : Distribution β where
    46	  support := 𝒟.support.image e
    47	  weight := fun b => ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b), 𝒟.weight a
    48	  nonnegative := fun _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => 𝒟.nonnegative a
    49	  outsideSupport := fun _ hb =>
    50	    Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a ha =>
    51	      (hb (Finset.mem_image.mpr
    52	        ⟨a, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).1, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩)).elim
    53	
    54	@[simp]
    55	theorem map_support {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    56	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) :
    57	    (𝒟.map e).support = 𝒟.support.image e := rfl
    58	
    59	@[simp]
    60	theorem map_weight {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    61	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (b : β) :
    62	    (𝒟.map e).weight b =
    63	      ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b), 𝒟.weight a := rfl
    64	
    65	/-- Push-forward preserves total mass. -/
    66	theorem map_totalWeight {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    67	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) :
    68	    (𝒟.map e).totalWeight = 𝒟.totalWeight := by
    69	  simpa [totalWeight, map] using
    70	    (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    71	      (s := 𝒟.support) (t := 𝒟.support.image e) (g := e)
    72	      (fun a ha => Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩) 𝒟.weight)
    73	
    74	/-- A finite weighted sum over a push-forward distribution is the corresponding
    75	weighted sum of the pulled-back family.  This is the `Distribution` analogue of
    76	the finite-sum form of `PMF.map`. -/
    77	theorem map_sum_smul {α β M : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
    78	    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Error M]
    79	    (𝒟 : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → M) :
    80	    ∑ b ∈ (𝒟.map e).support, (𝒟.map e).weight b • f b =
    81	      ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support, 𝒟.weight a • f (e a) := by
    82	  classical
    83	  calc
    84	    ∑ b ∈ 𝒟.support.image e,
    85	        (∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b), 𝒟.weight a) • f b
    86	        = ∑ b ∈ 𝒟.support.image e,
    87	            ∑ a ∈ 𝒟.support.filter (fun a => e a = b), 𝒟.weight a • f (e a) := by
    88	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    89	          intro b _
    90	          rw [Finset.sum_smul]
    91	          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_

     8	# Low-degree polynomial measurements and soundness
     9	
    10	The low-degree question laws have uniform point and coordinate-index marginals,
    11	and every sampled line is incident to its paired point.  Polynomial outcomes
    12	are bounded multivariate polynomials, and the corresponding projective
    13	strategies satisfy the low-degree soundness theorem used in the QPBT argument.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	The principal definition and theorem are `def:ld-meas` and `lem:ld-soundness` in
    18	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:164-202`. Their paper origin is
    19	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-287,392-480`.
    20	The dimension-divisibility hypothesis is documented in
    21	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`.
    22	-/

   278	/-- Bounded multivariate polynomials form a finite set over a finite coefficient
   279	semiring. This is the finite outcome set required by `def:ld-meas`,
   280	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:164-171`, paper
   281	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:394-408`. -/
   282	noncomputable instance polyFuncFintype (m : ℕ) (K : Type*)
   283	    [CommSemiring K] [Fintype K] (d : ℕ) : Fintype ↥(polyFunc m K d) := by
   284	  letI : Finite ↥(polyFunc m K d) := Module.finite_of_finite K
   285	  exact Fintype.ofFinite _
   286	
   287	/-- A bounded multivariate polynomial outcome over an arbitrary finite
   288	coefficient semiring. -/
   289	noncomputable abbrev PolyIndex (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
   290	    [Fintype K] (d : ℕ) := ↥(polyFunc m K d)
   291	
   292	/-- A POVM indexed by one bounded multivariate polynomial. -/
   293	noncomputable abbrev PolyMeas (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
   294	    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (d : ℕ) (ι : Type*)
   295	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
   296	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement (PolyIndex m K d) ι
   297	
   298	/-- The dependent family in `def:ld-meas`: component `i` may
   299	have its own coefficient field, number of variables, and degree bound.
   300	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:164-171`, paper
   301	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:394-408`. -/
   302	noncomputable abbrev PolyMeasFamily (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Type*)
   303	    [∀ i, CommSemiring (K i)] [∀ i, Fintype (K i)]
   304	    [∀ i, DecidableEq (K i)] (m d : Fin k → ℕ) (ι : Type*)
   305	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
   306	  MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement ((i : Fin k) → PolyIndex (m i) (K i) (d i)) ι
   307	
   308	/-- A simultaneous tuple of `L.k` bounded polynomial representatives. -/
   309	noncomputable abbrev PolyTuple (L : LdParams) :=
   310	  Fin L.k → PolyIndex L.m (ScalarQ L) L.d
   311	
   312	/-- The constant-family specialization used by `lem:ld-soundness`. -/
   313	noncomputable abbrev PolyMeasTuple (L : LdParams) (ι : Type*)
   314	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
   315	  PolyMeasFamily L.k (fun _ => ScalarQ L) (fun _ => L.m) (fun _ => L.d) ι
   316	
   317	/-- Evaluate every component of a polynomial tuple at a point. -/
   318	def evalPolyTupleAt {L : LdParams} (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)
   319	    (g : PolyTuple L) : Fin L.k → ScalarQ L :=
   320	  fun j => MvPolynomial.eval u (g j).1
   321	
   322	/-- Embed a geometric point into the ambient coefficient space used by a
   323	point question. -/
   324	def pointSpaceOf (L : LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) : LdSpace L :=
   325	  fun i => match i with
   326	  | .inl (.inl j) => u j
   327	  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   328	  | .inr _ => 0
   329	
   330	/-- The typed low-degree point question associated with `u`. -/
   331	def ldPointQuestionOf (L : LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) : LdQuestion L :=
   332	  (.point, pointSpaceOf L u)
   333	
   334	/-- Read the point component of a low-degree answer, sending answers of the
   335	wrong form to the fixed zero tuple. This total relabeling turns the strategy's
   336	answer measurement into the point POVM used by `lem:ld-soundness`. -/
   337	def ldPointValuesOrZero (L : LdParams) : LdAnswer L → Fin L.k → ScalarQ L
   338	  | .pointVals values => values
   339	  | .alinePolys _ => 0
   340	  | .dlinePolys _ => 0
   341	
   342	/-- The quantitative error function in `lem:ld-soundness`.  Its argument order
   343	is `(a, b, ε, q, m, d, k)`. -/
   344	noncomputable def deltaLd (a b ε : ℝ) (q m d k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   345	  a * Real.rpow (((d * m * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) a *
   346	    (Real.rpow ε b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
   347	      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))
   348	
   349	/-- Quantum soundness of the simultaneous classical low individual degree
   350	test (`lem:ld-soundness`, blueprint lines 177--202; paper theorem and proof
   351	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`).
   352	
   353	The first two consistency bounds compare the point-answer postprocessing of the
   354	strategy with evaluations of the polynomial measurements. Answers of the wrong
   355	form are folded into the zero tuple so that the point family remains a POVM.
   356	
   357	The source reduction still requires proofs of the claimed game correspondence
   358	and of the auxiliary parameter bound. These two open facts are detailed in
   359	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` and
   360	`rem:ld-soundness-provider`, and are tracked by issue #16. -/
   361	theorem exists_ld_soundness :
   362	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   363	      ∀ (L : LdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
   364	        ∀ S : Strategy (ldGame L), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
   365	          ∃ GA : PolyMeasTuple L S.ιA, ∃ GB : PolyMeasTuple L S.ιB,
   366	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   367	                (fun u outcome =>
   368	                  heteroKron
   369	                    (((S.A (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
   370	                      (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome) 1)
   371	                (fun u outcome =>
   372	                  heteroKron 1
   373	                    ((GB.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   374	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k ∧
   375	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   376	                (fun u outcome =>
   377	                  heteroKron
   378	                    ((GA.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
   379	                (fun u outcome =>
   380	                  heteroKron 1
   381	                    (((S.B (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
   382	                      (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome))
   383	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k ∧
   384	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   385	                (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
   386	                (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
   387	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k := by
   388	  sorry
   389	
   390	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Marginals of probability distributions
     6	
     7	The finite-distribution push-forward calculus gives corresponding identities
     8	for probability mass functions and for projections transported across finite
     9	equivalences.  These forms are used by the directly indexed low-degree
    10	line-point laws and by the correspondence between the seed-indexed and directly
    11	indexed question distributions.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	- `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-272`
    16	- `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`
    17	-/
    18	
    19	open scoped BigOperators
    20	
    21	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    22	
    23	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    24	
    25	/-- Two probabilistic finite distributions with the same stored support and
    26	the same associated probability mass function are equal.  This is the PMF form
    27	of `Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight`, retained for the low-degree
    28	marginal arguments that are stated using `Distribution.toPMF`. -/
    29	theorem distribution_eq_of_support_eq_of_toPMF_eq {alpha : Type*}
    30	    (mu nu : Distribution alpha) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
    31	    (hnu : nu.IsProbability) (hsupport : mu.support = nu.support)
    32	    (hpmf : mu.toPMF hmu = nu.toPMF hnu) : mu = nu := by
    33	  have hweight : mu.weight = nu.weight := by
    34	    funext a
    35	    calc
    36	      mu.weight a = (mu.toPMF hmu a).toReal :=
    37	        (Distribution.toPMF_apply_toReal mu hmu a).symm
    38	      _ = (nu.toPMF hnu a).toReal := by rw [hpmf]
    39	      _ = nu.weight a := Distribution.toPMF_apply_toReal nu hnu a
    40	  exact Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight hsupport hweight
    41	
    42	/-- Composition of two push-forwards of a probabilistic finite distribution
    43	is the push-forward by the composite map.  This probability-specialized form
    44	is retained for the directly indexed low-degree marginal theorems. -/
    45	theorem distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
    46	    {alpha beta gamma : Type*} [DecidableEq beta] [DecidableEq gamma]
    47	    (mu : Distribution alpha) (hmu : mu.IsProbability)
    48	    (f : alpha → beta) (g : beta → gamma) :
    49	    (mu.map f).map g = mu.map (g ∘ f) := by
    50	  change (mu.map f).map g = mu.map fun a => g (f a)
    51	  exact (fun _ : mu.IsProbability => Distribution.map_map mu f g) hmu
    52	
    53	/-- Projection onto the first factor of an explicit finite product
    54	equivalence sends the uniform distribution to the uniform first marginal.
    55	This form combines invariance under equivalence with the uniform first-marginal
    56	identity; it is `lem:uniform-first-marginal-after-equivalence` in blueprint
    57	chapter 13. -/
    58	theorem uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv
    59	    {alpha beta gamma : Type*}
    60	    [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] [Nonempty alpha]
    61	    [Fintype beta] [DecidableEq beta] [Nonempty beta]
    62	    [Finite gamma] [Nonempty gamma]
    63	    (e : alpha ≃ beta × gamma) (f : alpha → beta)
    64	    (hf : ∀ a, f a = (e a).1) :
    65	    (uniformDistribution alpha).map f = uniformDistribution beta := by
    66	  classical
    67	  letI : Fintype gamma := Fintype.ofFinite gamma
    68	  calc
    69	    (uniformDistribution alpha).map f =
    70	        (uniformDistribution alpha).map (fun a => (e a).1) := by
    71	      congr 1
    72	      funext a
    73	      exact hf a
    74	    _ = ((uniformDistribution alpha).map e).map Prod.fst :=
    75	      (Distribution.map_map _ _ _).symm
    76	    _ = (uniformDistribution (beta × gamma)).map Prod.fst := by
    77	      rw [uniformDistribution_map_equiv]
    78	    _ = uniformDistribution beta := uniformDistribution_map_fst
    79	
    80	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

70

    80	
    81	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint

    85	abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m

    93	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in

    96	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=

    99	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
   100	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.

   102	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=

   111	/-- The integer-coordinate map `χ` from the fixed field representation.  This
   112	is `eq:chi-func` in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   113	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   114	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   115	-/
   116	noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
   117	  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
   118	    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   119	  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))

   121	/-! ### Equal fibers of the coordinate-index map -/
   122	
   123	/-- The common residue set in a fiber of `chiIndex` is nonempty.  This is part
   124	of the exact seed decomposition supporting the balance assertion in
   125	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `lem:chi-seed-fibers`, paper
   126	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:215-221`.
   127	-/
   128	theorem LdParams.seedFiberCard_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   129	  exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by
   130	    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := L.hq
   131	    rw [hq]
   132	    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) L.hdvd) L.hm
   133	
   134	/-- Divisibility identifies the scalar cardinality with the product of the
   135	coordinate-index cardinality and the common fiber cardinality.  This supports
   136	`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   137	theorem LdParams.seedFiberProduct_eq (L : LdParams) :
   138	    L.q = L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
   139	  (Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd).symm

   141	/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
   142	natural-number representative. -/
   143	@[simp] private theorem equivCastFin_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (i : Fin m) :
   144	    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin h) i).val = i.val := by
   145	  subst n
   146	  rfl
   147	
   148	/-- A scalar seed is uniquely a coordinate index and a residue in its
   149	`chiIndex` fiber.  This is the exact decomposition underlying
   150	`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   151	noncomputable def seedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   152	    ScalarQ L ≃ Fin L.m × Fin (L.q / L.m) :=
   153	  (binaryRepresentation L.model).trans <|
   154	    (Equiv.cast <| congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq).trans
   155	      finProdFinEquiv.symm

   157	/-- The coordinate component of the exact seed decomposition is `chiIndex`. -/
   158	@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_fst (L : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ L) :
   159	    (seedFiberEquiv L s).1 = chiIndex L s := by
   160	  letI : NeZero L.m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm)⟩

   166	  apply Fin.ext

   169	      (binaryRepresentation L.model s)).val / (L.q / L.m) =
   170	      (Fin.ofNat L.m ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m))).val

   194	/-- The projection used in the diagonal-line map zeroes coordinates before the
   195	chosen index and retains the suffix of the direction vector.  This is the

   200	def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :

   202	  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j

   209	    (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   210	    prefixProjection i (prefixProjection i v) = prefixProjection i v := by
   211	  funext j

   273	/-- The ambient seed-indexed sample space is a direct sample together with a
   274	uniform residue in the selected seed fiber. -/
   275	noncomputable def ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   276	    LdSpace L ≃ DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams × Fin (L.q / L.m) where
   277	  toFun z :=
   278	    (⟨z.point, (seedFiberEquiv L z.seed).1, z.direction⟩,
   279	      (seedFiberEquiv L z.seed).2)
   280	  invFun x := ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L x.1 x.2
   281	  left_inv z := by
   282	    funext i
   283	    rcases i with (i | i)
   284	    · rcases i with (i | i)
   285	      · rfl
   286	      · rcases i with ⟨⟩
   287	        change (seedFiberEquiv L).symm (seedFiberEquiv L z.seed) = z.seed
   288	        exact (seedFiberEquiv L).symm_apply_apply z.seed
   289	    · rfl
   290	  right_inv x := by
   291	    rcases x with ⟨sample, residue⟩
   292	    apply Prod.ext
   293	    · cases sample with
   294	      | mk point index direction =>
   295	          simp only [ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point,
   296	            ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_seed, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction]

   309	  | point =>
   310	    rfl
   311	  | aline =>
   312	      ext <;>
   313	        simp only [parseLdQuestion, ldCL, ldALineCL, directLdMap,
   314	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue, ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_point, LdSpace.seed,
   315	          chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue]
   316	      congr 1
   317	  | dline =>

   319	        simp only [parseLdQuestion, ldCL, ldDLineCL, directLdMap,

   321	          ldSpaceOfDirectResidue_direction, LdSpace.seed,

   339	
   340	/-- The common source sample is a direct common sample together with its
   341	uniform seed-fiber residue. -/
   342	noncomputable def ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
   343	    ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) ≃
   344	      (((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) ×
   345	        Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   346	  (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl (LdType × LdType))
   347	    (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L)).trans
   348	      (Equiv.prodAssoc (LdType × LdType)
   349	        (DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) (Fin (L.q / L.m))).symm
   350	
   351	/-- Forget the seed residue while retaining the ordered question types and
   352	the directly indexed common sample. -/
   353	noncomputable def ldQuestionSampleProjection (L : LdParams) :
   354	    ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) →
   355	      (LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams :=
   356	  fun source => (source.1, (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L source.2).1)
   357	
   358	/-- Parse both questions in a seed-indexed question pair. -/
   359	noncomputable def parseLdQuestionPair (L : LdParams) :
   360	    (LdQuestion L × LdQuestion L) →
   361	      (DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams ×
   362	        DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams) :=
   363	  fun questions =>
   364	    (parseLdQuestion L questions.1, parseLdQuestion L questions.2)

   366	private theorem parse_ldQuestionSample (L : LdParams)
   367	    (source : (LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) :
   368	    parseLdQuestionPair L
   369	        ((source.1.1, ldCL L source.1.1 source.2),
   370	          (source.1.2, ldCL L source.1.2 source.2)) =
   371	      let direct := ldQuestionSampleProjection L source
   372	      ((direct.1.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams direct.1.1 direct.2),
   373	        (direct.1.2, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams direct.1.2 direct.2)) := by
   374	  let sample := (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L source.2).1
   375	  let residue := (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L source.2).2
   376	  have hsource :
   377	      source.2 = ldSpaceOfDirectResidue L sample residue := by
   378	    exact (ldSpaceSeedFiberEquiv L).symm_apply_apply source.2 |>.symm
   379	  rw [hsource]
   380	  apply Prod.ext
   381	  · exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L source.1.1 sample residue
   382	  · exact parseLdQuestion_ldCL_ofDirectResidue L source.1.2 sample residue

   384	/-- Pushing the seed-indexed question law through the exact parser gives the
   385	directly indexed question law, including the ordered type-pair weights. -/
   386	theorem ldQuestionDistribution_map_parse (L : LdParams) :
   387	    (ldQuestionDistribution L).map (parseLdQuestionPair L) =
   388	      directLdQuestionDistribution L.toDirectLdParams := by
   389	  letI : Nonempty (Fin (L.q / L.m)) :=
   390	    Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp L.seedFiberCard_pos
   391	  let sourceMap : ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L) →
   392	      LdQuestion L × LdQuestion L := fun source =>
   393	    ((source.1.1, ldCL L source.1.1 source.2),
   394	      (source.1.2, ldCL L source.1.2 source.2))
   395	  let directMap :
   396	      ((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) →
   397	        DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams ×
   398	          DirectLdQuestion L.toDirectLdParams := fun source =>
   399	    ((source.1.1, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams source.1.1 source.2),
   400	      (source.1.2, directLdMap L.toDirectLdParams source.1.2 source.2))
   401	  have huniform :
   402	      (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   403	          (ldQuestionSampleProjection L) =
   404	        uniformDistribution
   405	          ((LdType × LdType) × DirectLdSpace L.toDirectLdParams) := by
   406	    apply uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (ldQuestionSeedFiberEquiv L)
   407	    intro source
   408	    rfl
   409	  calc
   410	    (ldQuestionDistribution L).map (parseLdQuestionPair L) =
   411	        (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   412	          (parseLdQuestionPair L ∘ sourceMap) := by
   413	      exact distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
   414	        (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L))
   415	        (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   416	        sourceMap (parseLdQuestionPair L)
   417	    _ = (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   418	        (directMap ∘ ldQuestionSampleProjection L) := by
   419	      congr 1
   420	      funext source
   421	      exact parse_ldQuestionSample L source
   422	    _ = ((uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L)).map
   423	          (ldQuestionSampleProjection L)).map directMap :=
   424	      (distribution_map_map_of_isProbability
   425	        (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace L))
   426	        (uniformDistribution_isProbability _)
   427	        (ldQuestionSampleProjection L) directMap).symm
   428	    _ = directLdQuestionDistribution L.toDirectLdParams := by
   429	      rw [huniform]
   430	      rfl

     9	
    10	The low-degree question laws have uniform point and coordinate-index marginals,
    11	and every sampled line is incident to its paired point.  Polynomial outcomes
    12	are bounded multivariate polynomials, and the corresponding projective
    13	strategies satisfy the low-degree soundness theorem used in the QPBT argument.

    20	The dimension-divisibility hypothesis is documented in

    32	/-- A formalization-only identity used to construct canonical line
    33	descriptions: applying the canonical line-representative projection twice has
    34	the same effect as applying it once. -/
    35	theorem lineRepMap_apply_self {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : ℕ}
    36	    (v u : Fin m → K) :
    37	    lineRepMap v (lineRepMap v u) = lineRepMap v u := by
    38	  simp [lineRepMap, canonicalProjOfKernel, LinearMap.comp_apply]

    40	/-- The two presentations of lines used by the low-degree question sampler. -/
    41	inductive LineKind where
    42	  | axis
    43	  | diagonal
    44	  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype
    45	
    46	/-- A seed-bearing line description for `def:line-point-dist`, blueprint
    47	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:85-95`, paper
    48	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174,243-287`.
    49	
    50	An axis description stores its canonical base and seed. A diagonal description
    51	stores only the projected direction, together with its prefix-zero invariant.
    52	Both cases carry the assertion that their base is fixed by the
    53	appropriate `lineRepMap`. Coordinates are numbered from zero; coordinate `j`
    54	corresponds to the paper's coordinate `j + 1`. -/
    55	inductive LineDesc (L : LdParams) where
    56	  | axis (base : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (seed : ScalarQ L)
    57	      (baseFixed : lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex L seed)) base = base)
    58	  | diagonal (base : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (seed : ScalarQ L)
    59	      (direction : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)
    60	      (baseFixed : lineRepMap direction base = base)
    61	      (prefixZero : ∀ j : Fin L.m, j.val < (chiIndex L seed).val → direction j = 0)
    62	  deriving DecidableEq

    64	/-- The tag of a canonical line description. -/
    65	def LineDesc.kind {L : LdParams} : LineDesc L → LineKind

    67	  | .diagonal _ _ _ _ _ => .diagonal

    74	/-- The canonical base stored by a line description. -/

   120	/-- Extend a coefficient list by zero from degree bound `c` to `c'`. -/
   121	def DegPoly.padTo {L : LdParams} {c c' : ℕ} (_h : c ≤ c')

   126	/-- A line polynomial evaluates to `a` at `u` when `u` has a line parameter
   127	and every such parameter gives the same value.  The universal clause handles
   128	the zero-direction presentation without choosing a sentinel parameter. -/
   129	def EvaluatesTo {L : LdParams} {c : ℕ} (line : LineDesc L)
   130	    (f : DegPoly L c) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) (a : ScalarQ L) : Prop :=
   131	  (∃ t : ScalarQ L, u = line.base + t • line.direction) ∧
   132	    ∀ t : ScalarQ L, u = line.base + t • line.direction → evalCoefficient f t = a

   344	noncomputable def deltaLd (a b ε : ℝ) (q m d k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   345	  a * Real.rpow (((d * m * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) a *

   349	/-- Quantum soundness of the simultaneous classical low individual degree
   350	test (`lem:ld-soundness`, blueprint lines 177--202; paper theorem and proof
   351	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`).

   353	The first two consistency bounds compare the point-answer postprocessing of the
   354	strategy with evaluations of the polynomial measurements. Answers of the wrong
   355	form are folded into the zero tuple so that the point family remains a POVM.

   362	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   363	      ∀ (L : LdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
   364	        ∀ S : Strategy (ldGame L), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
   365	          ∃ GA : PolyMeasTuple L S.ιA, ∃ GB : PolyMeasTuple L S.ιB,

   367	                (fun u outcome =>
   368	                  heteroKron
   369	                    (((S.A (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
   370	                      (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome) 1)
   371	                (fun u outcome =>
   372	                  heteroKron 1
   373	                    ((GB.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   374	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k ∧
   375	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   376	                (fun u outcome =>
   377	                  heteroKron
   378	                    ((GA.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
   379	                (fun u outcome =>
   380	                  heteroKron 1
   381	                    (((S.B (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
   382	                      (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome))
   383	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k ∧
   384	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   385	                (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
   386	                (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
   387	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k := by
   388	  sorry

   199	/-- Two finite distributions coincide as soon as their supports and weight
   200	functions coincide.  This is the formalization support statement
   201	`lem:distribution-ext-support` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   202	theorem Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight {α : Type*} {μ ν : Distribution α}
   203	    (hsupport : μ.support = ν.support) (hweight : μ.weight = ν.weight) :
   204	    μ = ν := by
   205	  cases μ with
   206	  | mk s w hn ho =>
   207	    cases ν with
   208	    | mk s' w' hn' ho' =>
   209	      have hs : s = s' := hsupport
   210	      have hw : w = w' := hweight
   211	      subst hs
   212	      subst hw
   213	      rfl

   215	/-- Successive push-forwards of a finite distribution compose.  This is
   216	`lem:distribution-map-comp` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
   217	theorem Distribution.map_map {α β γ : Type*}
   218	    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
   219	    (μ : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → γ) :
   220	    (μ.map e).map f = μ.map fun a => f (e a) := by
   221	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   222	  · change (μ.support.image e).image f = μ.support.image fun a => f (e a)
   223	    rw [Finset.image_image]
   224	    rfl
   225	  · funext c
   226	    have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c,
   227	        e a ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c := by
   228	      intro a ha
   229	      obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
   230	      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha1, ha2⟩
   231	    have hkey := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps μ.weight
   232	    change (∑ b ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c,
   233	        ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => e a = b, μ.weight a) =
   234	      ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c, μ.weight a
   235	    rw [← hkey]
   236	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
   237	    obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
   238	    congr 1
   239	    ext a
   240	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
   241	    constructor
   242	    · rintro ⟨ha1, rfl⟩
   243	      exact ⟨⟨ha1, hb2⟩, rfl⟩
   244	    · rintro ⟨⟨ha1, -⟩, hae⟩
   245	      exact ⟨ha1, hae⟩

   252	    (uniformDistribution α).weight a = 1 / (Fintype.card α : Error) := by
   253	  simp [uniformDistribution]

   258	theorem uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber {α β : Type*}
   259	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
   260	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
   261	    (e : α → β) (c : ℕ)
   262	    (hc : ∀ b : β, ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b).card = c) :
   263	    (uniformDistribution α).map e = uniformDistribution β := by
   264	  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
   265	    obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty α)
   266	    have hmem : a₀ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = e a₀ :=

   268	    have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a₀, hmem⟩
   269	    rwa [hc] at hpos
   270	  have hcard : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card β * c := by
   271	    have h := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
   272	      (f := e) (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (t := (Finset.univ : Finset β))
   273	      (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
   274	    rw [Finset.card_univ] at h
   275	    rw [h, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hc b]
   276	    simp [Finset.card_univ, mul_comm]
   277	  refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   278	  · change (Finset.univ : Finset α).image e = (Finset.univ : Finset β)

   280	    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true, true_and]

   283	      exact hcpos

 import MIPStarRE.LDT.Basic.Distribution
 
 /-! # Operations on finite distributions
 
-Products, convex mixtures, dependent binds, and normalized restrictions used by
-the QPBT distributions, together with the generic push-forward calculus for
-finite and uniform distributions. Their source uses occur in the line-point
-sampler, typed conditionally linear distributions, sandwich products, and
-restricted line distributions cited below.
+Finite distributions support products, convex mixtures, dependent binds,
+normalized restrictions, and push-forwards.  Uniform laws are preserved by
+bijections and balanced maps, their product projections are uniform, and
+dependent uniform sampling agrees with push-forward from a product.
 -/
 
 open scoped BigOperators
 
 namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
 
 open MIPStarRE.LDT
 
 /-- The product of two finite distributions, a formalization-only auxiliary
 used by the sandwich construction; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-480`,
 paper `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
 noncomputable def Distribution.prod {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
     (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β) : Distribution (α × β) where
   support := μ.support.product ν.support
   weight p := μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2
   nonnegative p := mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative p.1) (ν.nonnegative p.2)
   outsideSupport p hp := by
     by_cases hμ : p.1 ∈ μ.support
     · have hν : p.2 ∉ ν.support := by
         intro h
         exact hp (Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hμ, h⟩)
       simp [ν.outsideSupport p.2 hν]
     · simp [μ.outsideSupport p.1 hμ]
 
 /-- The product of two probability distributions is a probability
 distribution; blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:454-480`, paper
 `06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:465-501`. -/
 theorem Distribution.prod_isProbability {α β : Type*}
     [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (μ : Distribution α) (ν : Distribution β)
     (hμ : μ.IsProbability) (hν : ν.IsProbability) :
     (Distribution.prod μ ν).IsProbability := by
   simp only [Distribution.IsProbability, Distribution.totalWeight,
     Distribution.prod]
   calc
     (∑ p ∈ μ.support.product ν.support, μ.weight p.1 * ν.weight p.2) =
         ∑ a ∈ μ.support, ∑ b ∈ ν.support, μ.weight a * ν.weight b := by
       exact Finset.sum_product' μ.support ν.support
         (fun a b => μ.weight a * ν.weight b)
     _ =
         ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * ∑ b ∈ ν.support, ν.weight b := by
       apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
       intro a _
       exact (Finset.mul_sum ν.support (fun b => ν.weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm
     _ = ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a := by
       rw [hν.weight_sum_eq_one]
       simp
     _ = 1 := hμ.weight_sum_eq_one
 
 /-- The convex mixture with a coefficient in `[0,1]`, as used for
 the equal mixture in `def:line-point-dist`, blueprint
 `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:125-135`, paper
 `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
 noncomputable def Distribution.mix {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
     (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
     (μ ν : Distribution α) : Distribution α where
   support := μ.support ∪ ν.support
   weight a := t * μ.weight a + (1 - t) * ν.weight a
   nonnegative a := by
     exact add_nonneg
       (mul_nonneg ht0 (μ.nonnegative a))
       (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) (ν.nonnegative a))
   outsideSupport a ha := by
     have hμ : a ∉ μ.support := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_union_left _ h)
     have hν : a ∉ ν.support := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_union_right _ h)
     simp [μ.outsideSupport a hμ, ν.outsideSupport a hν]
 
 /-- A convex mixture of probability distributions is a probability distribution;
 `def:line-point-dist`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:125-135`, paper
 `08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:274-287`. -/
 theorem Distribution.mix_isProbability {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
     (t : ℝ) (μ ν : Distribution α) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
     (hν : ν.IsProbability) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
     (Distribution.mix t ht0 ht1 μ ν).IsProbability := by
   have hμ_union :
       ∑ a ∈ μ.support ∪ ν.support, μ.weight a = 1 := by
     apply hμ.weight_sum_eq_one_of_subset
     intro a ha
     exact Finset.mem_union_left ν.support ha
   have hν_union :
       ∑ a ∈ μ.support ∪ ν.support, ν.weight a = 1 := by
     apply hν.weight_sum_eq_one_of_subset
     intro a ha
     exact Finset.mem_union_right μ.support ha
   simp only [Distribution.IsProbability, Distribution.totalWeight,
     Distribution.mix]
   rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
     hμ_union, hν_union]
   ring
 
 /-- The dependent bind of finite distributions used for typed question
 distributions, blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1400-1404`, paper
 `07_types.tex:84-94`. -/
 noncomputable def Distribution.bind {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
     (μ : Distribution α) (ν : α → Distribution β) : Distribution β where
   support := μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support)
   weight b := ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a * (ν a).weight b
   nonnegative b := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => mul_nonneg (μ.nonnegative a) ((ν a).nonnegative b)
   outsideSupport b hb := by
     apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
     intro a ha
     have hnot : b ∉ (ν a).support := by
       intro h
       exact hb (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨a, ha, h⟩)
     simp [ν a |>.outsideSupport b hnot]
 
 /-- A dependent bind of probability distributions is a probability distribution;
 blueprint
 `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1400-1404`, paper `07_types.tex:84-94`. -/
 theorem Distribution.bind_isProbability {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq β]
     (μ : Distribution α) (ν : α → Distribution β) (hμ : μ.IsProbability)
     (hν : ∀ a ∈ μ.support, (ν a).IsProbability) :
     (Distribution.bind μ ν).IsProbability := by
   classical
   have hν_union (a : α) (ha : a ∈ μ.support) :
       ∑ b ∈ μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support), (ν a).weight b = 1 := by
     apply (hν a ha).weight_sum_eq_one_of_subset
     intro b hb
     exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
   simp only [Distribution.IsProbability, Distribution.totalWeight,
     Distribution.bind]
   rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   calc
     (∑ a ∈ μ.support,
         ∑ b ∈ μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support),
           μ.weight a * (ν a).weight b) =
         ∑ a ∈ μ.support,
           μ.weight a *
             ∑ b ∈ μ.support.biUnion (fun a => (ν a).support),
               (ν a).weight b := by
       apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
       intro a _
       exact (Finset.mul_sum _ (fun b => (ν a).weight b) (μ.weight a)).symm
     _ = ∑ a ∈ μ.support, μ.weight a := by
       apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
       intro a ha
       rw [hν_union a ha]
       simp
     _ = 1 := hμ.weight_sum_eq_one
 
 /-- Restrict a distribution to a decidable positive-mass event and normalize it,
 as in `def:ith-restricted-line`; blueprint
 `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:600-618`, paper
 `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
 noncomputable def Distribution.restrict {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
     (μ : Distribution α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
     (hpos : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a) : Distribution α where
   support := μ.support.filter p
   weight a := if p a then μ.weight a / ∑ b ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight b else 0
   nonnegative a := by
     split
     · exact div_nonneg (μ.nonnegative a) (le_of_lt hpos)
     · exact le_rfl
   outsideSupport a ha := by
     by_cases hp : p a
     · have hμ : a ∉ μ.support := fun h => ha (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨h, hp⟩)
       simp [hp, μ.outsideSupport a hμ]
     · simp [hp]
 
 /-- Restriction to a positive-mass event preserves total probability;
 `def:ith-restricted-line`, blueprint
 `ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:600-618`, paper
 `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1038-1048`. -/
 theorem Distribution.restrict_isProbability {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
     (μ : Distribution α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
     (hpos : 0 < ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a) :
     (Distribution.restrict μ p hpos).IsProbability := by
   simp only [Distribution.IsProbability, Distribution.totalWeight,
     Distribution.restrict]
   calc
     (∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p,
         if p a then μ.weight a / ∑ b ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight b else 0) =
         ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p,
           μ.weight a / ∑ b ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight b := by
       apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
       intro a ha
       rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2]
     _ = (∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight a) /
         ∑ b ∈ μ.support.filter p, μ.weight b := by
       rw [Finset.sum_div]
     _ = 1 := div_self hpos.ne'
 
 /-! ### Push-forwards of finite and uniform distributions
 
 The results of this section are not named in the paper.  They record the
 elementary behaviour of push-forwards of finite distributions, and of uniform
 distributions on finite types, that the line-point samplers of the low-degree
 game and the identification of question distributions with typed conditionally
 linear distributions rely on.
 -/
 
-/-- Two finite distributions coincide as soon as their supports and their
-weight functions coincide.  Formalization-only extensionality principle for
-`Distribution`. -/
+/-- Two finite distributions coincide as soon as their supports and weight
+functions coincide.  This is the formalization support statement
+`lem:distribution-ext-support` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight {α : Type*} {μ ν : Distribution α}
     (hsupport : μ.support = ν.support) (hweight : μ.weight = ν.weight) :
     μ = ν := by
   cases μ with
   | mk s w hn ho =>
     cases ν with
     | mk s' w' hn' ho' =>
       have hs : s = s' := hsupport
       have hw : w = w' := hweight
       subst hs
       subst hw
       rfl
 
-/-- Successive push-forwards of a finite distribution compose.
-Formalization-only auxiliary for `Distribution.map`. -/
+/-- Successive push-forwards of a finite distribution compose.  This is
+`lem:distribution-map-comp` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem Distribution.map_map {α β γ : Type*}
     [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq γ]
     (μ : Distribution α) (e : α → β) (f : β → γ) :
     (μ.map e).map f = μ.map fun a => f (e a) := by
   refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   · change (μ.support.image e).image f = μ.support.image fun a => f (e a)
     rw [Finset.image_image]
     rfl
   · funext c
     have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c,
         e a ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c := by
       intro a ha
       obtain ⟨ha1, ha2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
       exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha1, ha2⟩
     have hkey := Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to hmaps μ.weight
     change (∑ b ∈ (μ.support.image e).filter fun b => f b = c,
         ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => e a = b, μ.weight a) =
       ∑ a ∈ μ.support.filter fun a => f (e a) = c, μ.weight a
     rw [← hkey]
     refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
     obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hb
     congr 1
     ext a
     simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
     constructor
     · rintro ⟨ha1, rfl⟩
       exact ⟨⟨ha1, hb2⟩, rfl⟩
     · rintro ⟨⟨ha1, -⟩, hae⟩
       exact ⟨ha1, hae⟩
 
-/-- Every point of a finite type carries the same uniform weight.
-Formalization-only auxiliary for `uniformDistribution`. -/
+/-- Every point of a nonempty finite type carries the reciprocal of the type's
+cardinality as its uniform weight.  This is `lem:uniform-distribution-weight`
+in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem uniformDistribution_weight_apply (α : Type*)
     [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α] (a : α) :
     (uniformDistribution α).weight a = 1 / (Fintype.card α : Error) := by
   simp [uniformDistribution]
 
 /-- A map whose fibers all have the same cardinality pushes the uniform
-distribution forward to the uniform distribution.  Formalization-only
-auxiliary for `uniformDistribution`. -/
+distribution forward to the uniform distribution.  This is
+`lem:uniform-map-equal-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber {α β : Type*}
     [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
     [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β]
     (e : α → β) (c : ℕ)
     (hc : ∀ b : β, ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b).card = c) :
     (uniformDistribution α).map e = uniformDistribution β := by
   have hcpos : 0 < c := by
     obtain ⟨a₀⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty α)
     have hmem : a₀ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = e a₀ :=
       Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
     have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a₀, hmem⟩
     rwa [hc] at hpos
   have hcard : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card β * c := by
     have h := Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
       (f := e) (s := (Finset.univ : Finset α)) (t := (Finset.univ : Finset β))
       (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
     rw [Finset.card_univ] at h
     rw [h, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => hc b]
     simp [Finset.card_univ, mul_comm]
   refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   · change (Finset.univ : Finset α).image e = (Finset.univ : Finset β)
     ext b
     simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true, true_and]
     have hne : ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b).Nonempty := by
       rw [← Finset.card_pos, hc]
       exact hcpos
     obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne
     exact ⟨a, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩
   · funext b
     have hbeta : (Fintype.card β : Error) ≠ 0 := by
       exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := β)
     have hc' : (c : Error) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcpos.ne'
     change (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => e a = b,
         (uniformDistribution α).weight a) = (uniformDistribution β).weight b
     rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => uniformDistribution_weight_apply α a,
       uniformDistribution_weight_apply, Finset.sum_const, hc, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
     push_cast
     field_simp
 
-/-- Relabelling along a bijection preserves uniformity.  Formalization-only
-auxiliary for `uniformDistribution`. -/
+/-- Relabelling along a bijection preserves uniformity.  This is
+`lem:uniform-map-equivalence` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem uniformDistribution_map_equiv {α β : Type*}
     [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
     [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] (E : α ≃ β) :
     (uniformDistribution α).map E = uniformDistribution β := by
   refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ 1 fun b => ?_
   have hfilter :
       ((Finset.univ : Finset α).filter fun a => E a = b) = {E.symm b} := by
     ext a
     simp [Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply]
   rw [hfilter]
   simp
 
 /-- The first marginal of the uniform distribution on a product is uniform.
-Formalization-only auxiliary for `uniformDistribution`. -/
+This is `lem:uniform-product-first-marginal` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem uniformDistribution_map_fst {α β : Type*}
     [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
     [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
     (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map Prod.fst = uniformDistribution α := by
   refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ (Fintype.card β) fun a => ?_
   have hfilter : ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => p.1 = a)
       = ({a} : Finset α) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset β) := by
     ext p
     simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_product,
       Finset.mem_singleton, and_true]
   rw [hfilter, Finset.card_product]
   simp
 
 /-- The second marginal of the uniform distribution on a product is uniform.
-Formalization-only auxiliary for `uniformDistribution`. -/
+This is `lem:uniform-product-second-marginal` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem uniformDistribution_map_snd {α β : Type*}
     [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
     [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] :
     (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map Prod.snd = uniformDistribution β := by
   refine uniformDistribution_map_of_card_fiber _ (Fintype.card α) fun b => ?_
   have hfilter : ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => p.2 = b)
       = (Finset.univ : Finset α) ×ˢ ({b} : Finset β) := by
     ext p
     simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_product,
       Finset.mem_singleton]
   rw [hfilter, Finset.card_product]
   simp
 
 /-- Binding a uniform distribution to a family of uniformly seeded
 push-forwards is the push-forward of the uniform distribution on the product.
-Formalization-only auxiliary for `Distribution.bind`. -/
+This is `lem:uniform-bind-map` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
 theorem bind_uniformDistribution_map {α β γ : Type*}
     [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty α]
     [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Nonempty β] [DecidableEq γ]
     (g : α → β → γ) :
     Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution α)
         (fun a => (uniformDistribution β).map (g a)) =
       (uniformDistribution (α × β)).map fun p => g p.1 p.2 := by
   refine Distribution.ext_of_support_of_weight ?_ ?_
   · change (Finset.univ : Finset α).biUnion
         (fun a => (Finset.univ : Finset β).image (g a)) =
       (Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).image fun p => g p.1 p.2
     ext c
     simp [Prod.exists]
   · funext c
     have hcount :
         ((Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => g p.1 p.2 = c).card
           = ∑ a : α, ((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card := by
       simp only [Finset.card_filter]
       rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
     have hinner : ∀ a : α,
         ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c
           = (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : Error) *
               (1 / (Fintype.card β : Error)) := by
       intro a
       change (∑ b ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c,
           (uniformDistribution β).weight b) = _
       rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => uniformDistribution_weight_apply β b,
         Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
     have key : ∀ a : α, (uniformDistribution α).weight a *
         ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c
         = (((Finset.univ : Finset β).filter fun b => g a b = c).card : Error) *
             (1 / ((Fintype.card α : Error) * (Fintype.card β : Error))) := by
       intro a
       rw [uniformDistribution_weight_apply, hinner a]
       ring
     change (∑ a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α), (uniformDistribution α).weight a *
         ((uniformDistribution β).map (g a)).weight c) =
       ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (α × β)).filter fun p => g p.1 p.2 = c,
         (uniformDistribution (α × β)).weight p
     rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => key a, ← Finset.sum_mul,
       Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => uniformDistribution_weight_apply (α × β) p,
       Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hcount, Fintype.card_prod]
     push_cast
     ring
 
 end MIPStarRE.QPBT

 structure LdParams where
   q : ℕ
   m : ℕ
   d : ℕ
   k : ℕ
   hm : 1 ≤ m
   hd : 1 ≤ d
   hk : 1 ≤ k
   hq : IsAdmissibleSize q

 instance (L : LdParams) : Nonempty (Fin L.m) :=
   ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm⟩⟩

   letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
     exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
 
+/-! ### Equal fibers of the coordinate-index map -/
+
+/-- The common residue set in a fiber of `chiIndex` is nonempty.  This is part
+of the exact seed decomposition supporting the balance assertion in
+`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `lem:chi-seed-fibers`, paper
+`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:215-221`.
+-/
+theorem LdParams.seedFiberCard_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
+  exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by
+    obtain ⟨n, hn, hq⟩ := L.hq
+    rw [hq]
+    exact Nat.pow_pos (by decide)) L.hdvd) L.hm
+
+/-- Divisibility identifies the scalar cardinality with the product of the
+coordinate-index cardinality and the common fiber cardinality.  This supports
+`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
+theorem LdParams.seedFiberProduct_eq (L : LdParams) :
+    L.q = L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
+  (Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd).symm
+
+/-- Casting between equal finite cardinalities preserves the underlying
+natural-number representative. -/
+@[simp] private theorem equivCastFin_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (i : Fin m) :
+    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin h) i).val = i.val := by
+  subst n
+  rfl
+
+/-- A scalar seed is uniquely a coordinate index and a residue in its
+`chiIndex` fiber.  This is the exact decomposition underlying
+`lem:chi-seed-fibers` in blueprint chapter 13. -/
+noncomputable def seedFiberEquiv (L : LdParams) :
+    ScalarQ L ≃ Fin L.m × Fin (L.q / L.m) :=
+  (binaryRepresentation L.model).trans <|
+    (Equiv.cast <| congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq).trans
+      finProdFinEquiv.symm
+
+/-- The coordinate component of the exact seed decomposition is `chiIndex`. -/
+@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_fst (L : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ L) :
+    (seedFiberEquiv L s).1 = chiIndex L s := by
+  letI : NeZero L.m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm)⟩
+  have hquot : (binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
+    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul L.seedFiberCard_pos).mpr
+    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd]
+    exact (binaryRepresentation L.model s).isLt
+  simp only [seedFiberEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
+  apply Fin.ext
+  change
+    (Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin L.seedFiberProduct_eq)
+      (binaryRepresentation L.model s)).val / (L.q / L.m) =
+      (Fin.ofNat L.m ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m))).val
+  rw [equivCastFin_val]
+  · exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hquot).symm
+  · exact L.seedFiberProduct_eq
+
+/-- Reconstruct the scalar seed belonging to a coordinate and its fiber
+residue. -/
+noncomputable def seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
+    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) : ScalarQ L :=
+  (seedFiberEquiv L).symm (i, r)
+
+/-- Decomposing a reconstructed seed recovers its coordinate and residue. -/
+@[simp] theorem seedFiberEquiv_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
+    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
+    seedFiberEquiv L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = (i, r) :=
+  (seedFiberEquiv L).apply_symm_apply (i, r)
+
+/-- A reconstructed seed belongs to the prescribed `chiIndex` fiber. -/
+@[simp] theorem chiIndex_seedOfIndexResidue (L : LdParams)
+    (i : Fin L.m) (r : Fin (L.q / L.m)) :
+    chiIndex L (seedOfIndexResidue L i r) = i := by
+  rw [← seedFiberEquiv_fst]

 -/
 def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
     Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j

+theorem prefixProjection_idempotent {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m)
+    (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :

 `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.

   fun i => match i with
   | .inl (.inl j) => z (.inl (.inl j))
   | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   | .inr _ => 0

 -/
 noncomputable def ldALineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   let rep := lineRepMap (coordinateDirection i)
   fun i => match i with
   | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   | .inr _ => 0

 `def:ld-question-distribution` (blueprint
 `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper origin
 `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
 -/
 noncomputable def ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   let direction := prefixProjection i (z.direction)
   let rep := lineRepMap direction
   fun i => match i with
   | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   | .inr j => direction j

 construction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
 `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
 `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
 -/
 noncomputable def ldCL (P : LdParams) : LdType → LdSpace P → LdSpace P
   | .point => ldPointCL P
   | .aline => ldALineCL P
   | .dline => ldDLineCL P

   Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P)

 coordinate and clearing every other coordinate. -/
 private def ldSeedLinear (P : LdParams) :
     LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   toFun x := fun i =>
     match i with
     | .inl (.inl _) => 0
     | .inl (.inr _) => x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
     | .inr _ => 0
